2609.18804.title: Beyond frequency measures: Can contextual embeddings capture meaning change in scientific texts?
2609.18804.paper_summary: Identifying technological trends is a core scientometric task, yet traditional frequency-based approaches struggle to capture substantial meaning shifts of domain-specific terms. We hypothesise that contextual embeddings can complement frequency dynamics to effectively track diachronic semantic change. We compare frequency and embedding-based approaches across Astrophysics and NLP corpora spanning from 2010 to 2024. Candidate terms are extracted using KeyBERT (utilizing SciBERT as its underlying language model) and filtered for significant frequency increases using Fisher's exact test. These terms are then evaluated for genuine semantic shift by domain experts to establish ground-truth labels. To quantify semantic drift, each term's contextual embedding ''clouds'' from the two discrete periods are compared using multiple metrics: cosine distance, average pairwise distance, Hotelling-type T 2 , and maximum mean discrepancy. Results indicate that frequency-based methods align slightly better with human judgments of ''trend-related terms'' than semantic metrics (Precision@50 of 0.62 vs 0.60 in Astrophysics). The two signals show a correlation of around 0.6. Several terms identified exclusively by embedding metrics (e.g., ''primordial black holes'') represent critical conceptual developments invisible to pure frequency analysis. These findings indicate that semantic metrics may capture complementary information, highlighting the value of integrating contextual embeddings into scientometric trend analysis.
2609.18804.paper_summary_zh: 識別技術趨勢是一項核心的科學計量任務，但傳統的基於頻率的方法在捕捉特定領域術語的實質意義變化方面存在困難。我們假設上下文嵌入可以補充頻率動態，以有效追蹤歷時語義變化。我們比較了2010年至2024年間的天體物理學和自然語言處理語料庫中的頻率和嵌入基礎方法。候選術語使用KeyBERT（以SciBERT作為其底層語言模型）提取，並使用Fisher精確檢驗過濾出顯著的頻率增加。這些術語隨後由領域專家評估其真實的語義變化，以建立真實標籤。為了量化語義漂移，對於兩個不同時期的每個術語的上下文嵌入“雲”使用多種指標進行比較：餘弦距離、平均成對距離、Hotelling類型的T²和最大均值差異。結果顯示，基於頻率的方法與人類對“趨勢相關術語”的判斷稍微更一致（在天體物理學中的Precision@50為0.62對0.60）。這兩種信號的相關性約為0.6。幾個僅由嵌入指標識別的術語（例如“原始黑洞”）代表了純頻率分析所無法察覺的關鍵概念發展。這些發現表明，語義指標可能捕捉到互補的信息，突顯了將上下文嵌入整合到科學計量趨勢分析中的價值。
